market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with bank-led support offset by housing and rate-hike anxiety. Oil strength supports energy names. Bathla fallout may trigger construction-sector volatility. Expect 1–2% index swings around RBA commentary.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural headwinds from housing correction, stalling GDP, and energy transition costs cap upside. However, gas pricing, rare earths, and AI infrastructure offer sector-specific growth. A 6–12 month consolidation in ^AXJO with selective outperformance in energy and small-cap miners is the base case.
